 ('radius6',[str(native/'exhaustive_fusions_lazy'),str(native/'radius6.input'),str(work/'radius6')]),
 ('radius8',[str(native/'exhaustive_fusions_lazy'),str(native/'radius8.input'),str(work/'radius8')]),
 ('closure8',[sys.executable,'-B','machine/code/check_window_invariant.py',str(native/'radius8.input'),'--output',str(work/'closure8.json')]),
 ('differential',[sys.executable,'-B','machine/code/test_exhaustive_pruning.py',str(native/'exhaustive_fusions_lazy'),'--output',str(work/'differential.json')]),
 ('single-rotations',[sys.executable,'-B','machine/code/joint_rotation_search.py','--runtime-only','--seconds','1000000','--output',str(work/'single-rotations.json')]),
 ('rotation0',[sys.executable,'-B','machine/code/joint_rotation_search.py','--single','0','--seconds','1000000','--output',str(work/'rotation0.json')]),
 ('multi20261017',[sys.executable,'-B','machine/code/multi_rotation_search.py','--iterations','20000','--seed','20261017','--seconds','1000000','--output',str(work/'multi20261017.json')]),
 ('multi20261018',[sys.executable,'-B','machine/code/multi_rotation_search.py','--iterations','46413','--seed','20261018','--seconds','1000000','--output',str(work/'multi20261018.json')]),
]
def run(job):
    name,cmd=job;t=time.monotonic()
    with (work/(name+'.log')).open('w') as f:
        p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=base,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    row=dict(name=name,command=cmd,cwd=str(base),exit_code=p.returncode,elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-t)

    return row
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool: rows=list(pool.map(run,jobs))
